sourceOfTruth: Domain JSON files listed in domains; wire-contract.json is the assembled compatibility artifact for existing Rust include_str and frontend consumers.

generation.reason: Generating raw DTO structures could cover field sets and unions, but would not replace handwritten semantic normalization, current-time eligibility, and request/response binding checks. This pass preserves those decoders and organizes existing fixture coverage before introducing a generator.
generation.scope: Existing golden records only. A record demonstrates selected values, not every field, variant, public DTO, or bridge method. No claim of complete RuntimeBridge coverage.

lifecycleCoverage.caseFormat: valid maps case names to native-serialized payloads; invalid clones the named base and replaces the field at path with value, or removes that field when value is absent.
lifecycleCoverage.AgentStatus: Both wire variants, including bootstrap step and rejection of contradictory ready/step payloads; bootstrap step strings are not enumerated.
lifecycleCoverage.AgentProcessInfo: Required nullable fields, absent/owned/external processes, independently unavailable executable and start time, numeric validation and metadata/ownership requiring a PID.
lifecycleCoverage.AppLockState: All mechanism/locked/available combinations emitted by native code, unavailable reason requirements, and selected malformed fields.
lifecycleCoverage.MaintenanceSnapshot: All state, kind, phase, operation and disposition variants represented; variant-specific field requirements and contradictions checked. Operation failure and service restoration remain independent.
lifecycleCoverage.nativeAssertions: Production AgentStatusDto conversion, AgentProcessInfo, LockStateDto, MaintenanceSnapshot, MaintenanceOperationOutcome, MaintenanceDisposition and AgentError serialization match every positive lifecycle case. Negative mutations exercise frontend semantic decoders, not native deserialization.

application: Lifecycle cases cover variants, not all values, kind/phase cross-products, temporal generation/revision ordering, native state transitions, CommandError codes/details, or every operation/disposition combination.

WindowStateEvent and DropHoverEvent lack shared native serialization fixtures; their production payload constructors are private. Unknown extension fields remain tolerated except contradictory fields belonging to another known lifecycle variant.
vault: CatalogDto absent generation, node-kind and role variants
groups: Party and FederationEntry variants, per-detail failures, inactive/adhoc discovered groups
servers: Nullable host/chat support, checked server version ranges, profile reconciliation identity and compatibility outcomes, reset artifact variants
enrollment: GoProfileCandidate eligibility variants, pending-operation kinds, incomplete enrollment variants
commands: CommandError details and codes, ambiguous outcomes, positive download result
yubikey: Command-specific variants beyond the selected success examples
scope: Request DTOs, event payloads, primitive responses, and optional bridge methods are not exhaustively inventoried by the native golden fixture.
Uncovered means absent from this shared golden fixture, not necessarily absent from handwritten unit tests.
Golden records containing synthetic plaintext, phrases, or tokens validate wire decoding only and are never metadata-cache inputs.
